scope: One grouped-OOF-only Phase 0.5 keep/reject test. This contract does not authorize held-out label access, held-out prediction, another residual design, or challenge-data use.

topology_audit.source_disclosure: The research CSV contains authorized grouped-OOF training targets. The topology audit consumed only task, fold, family, and nearest-neighbor similarity fields.

candidate.name: similarity_shrunk_knn_residual
candidate.abstention: Rows with nearest_neighbor_similarity < 0.5 receive weight 0 and exactly reproduce the base prediction.

controls.shuffled_residual: Within each benchmark/task/fold, deterministically permute local-minus-base residuals while preserving each row's similarity weight.
controls.randomized_family_label: Within each benchmark/task/fold, deterministically permute similarity weights while preserving each row's local-minus-base residual.
controls.selection_rule: Controls are diagnostics only and cannot be selected or retained.

metrics.interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval for the directional gain over global-only, resampling paired rows within each fold

retention_rule.full_population: Positive directional point gain over global-only on all four tasks.
retention_rule.analog_supported_population: Positive directional point gain and positive paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound over global-only on all four tasks.
retention_rule.fold_consistency: Positive directional gain in at least three of four grouped folds for every task.
retention_rule.remote_population: Predictions and metrics must be exactly unchanged because the candidate abstains.
retention_rule.negative_controls: The valid residual must beat both controls on the full and analog-supported populations for every task.
retention_rule.decision: Retain only if every condition passes. Otherwise record the negative result and remove the residual implementation.
